title: Failed section summaries retry at startup, at most three times
description: Found by the ARA-100 agent: a section_summaries job that fails after its three in-run attempts stays failed for good. queue_section_summaries treats any existing job row for that reading as done, and the manual retry refuses it (409 NEW_GENERATION_REQUEST_REQUIRED) to avoid replaying paid inference. Retrieval works without section summaries, but that PDF never gets them. The user decided on 2026-10-10: "Yes, do the capped retry for section summaries". The lead proposed retrying at the next restart, capped at three extra paid attempts per reading.
acceptance_criteria: Given a ready, active PDF whose current reading has only failed section-summary jobs and no stored section summaries, when the API starts (backfill_section_summaries), then the failed job is revived once, with fresh attempts and a new generation and outbox event, using the current saved default model and effort, and its revival count goes up by one.
Given a reading whose section-summary job has already been revived three times, when the API starts again, then nothing is queued and no paid call is made.
Given the saved default can't summarize (summary_blocker), when the API starts, then the failed job is not revived and its revival count is unchanged.
Given two API processes starting at once, when both run the backfill, then a failed job is revived at most once (row locks; the state change removes it from the selection).
Given a reading that already has section summaries, or a queued or processing job, when the API starts, then nothing changes, as before.
test_cases: Integration: failed job revived on backfill; revivals counter increments; payload model and effort follow the current default.
Integration: blocked default means not revived and the counter is unchanged.
Existing section summary tests stay green.
commits: feat(jobs): revive failed section summaries at startup, at most three times (ARA-105)
verification: 2026-10-10. Red first: tests/test_section_summary_revival_integration.py (6 tests) against unchanged code: 3 failed (revival, concurrent, newest-row) and 3 passed vacuously (cap, blocked default, queued or finished: nothing was ever revived). Green after the change: 6 passed; with the section-summary and storage-cleanup recovery files, 34 passed. Full backend suite (scripts/test-stack.py, ara-activity-test): 1222 passed in 278 s, run before the final merge of feat/ux-feedback-round, which brought no backend change to these files. Ruff check clean. A test bug was fixed on the way: the older-history test first called backfill inside the open transaction that added the row, so it saw nothing.
